calibration_profile.certificate: exhaustive feasible inventory hash plus exact Endpoint 1 and maximum-compatible-subset proof
calibration_profile.exactness: every mask has one sealed exact fidelity record and the inventory count/hash matches 262144
calibration_profile.mask_universe: 2 attention heads plus 16 individual MLP neurons
calibration_profile.transfer_limit: calibrates procedure behavior only on this small instance; no automatic main-scale error bound

discovery_profiles.backend_determinism: Stage 14 must qualify the actual CPU/CUDA/MPS backend. MPS has no presumed authority; a school-Mac MPS class becomes eligible only after exact and semantic qualification on that class, otherwise its qualified MPS throughput is zero and CPU is used.
discovery_profiles.exact_allowance_semantics: 256 total exact evaluations per model-method ledger, including the mandatory intact mask; duplicate requests reuse evidence and do not recharge the ledger
failure_rules: nonfinite optimization is terminal numerical failure
budget exhaustion is censored, not success
interruption resumes from a hash-bound checkpoint
discovery_profiles.intact_mask: always included and exactly evaluated so Endpoint 1 is defined up to 1.0

methods.termination: all ranked proposals consumed, exact allowance exhausted, or explicit failure

endpoint_profile.censoring_rule: budget exhaustion or incomplete candidate inventory is procedure-censored
endpoint_profile.failure_rule: retain zero from valid empty qualification; distinguish solver/search failure from zero
endpoint_profile.overlap_metric: Jaccard overlap of retained components in the declared basis

sensitivity_grid.execution: reducer-only from masks and exact fidelities already present in each sealed ledger; no rediscovery, new model inference, new exact evaluation, or ledger mutation

hierarchy.key_secondary: packing at component cap 0.25 and maximum Jaccard overlap 0.25

sensitivity_grid.ledger_limit: if a mask is absent from the sealed ledger, no sensitivity cell may generate or evaluate it

endpoint_profile.solver: exact maximum compatible subset with lexicographically smallest mask-identity tuple tie-break

fidelity_profile.accumulation_order: canonical example order then class order
fidelity_profile.denominator_guard: denominator exactly zero is undefined and rejected; every positive finite denominator is valid
fidelity_profile.ledger_reuse: reducer-only for all masks already present; never duplicate a discovery job

combinatorial.matching: exact retained size and component-type counts
combinatorial.replacement: independent seeded draws with duplicates retained and reported

local_perturbation.seed_masks: up to four lexicographically first exactly qualified masks

ordinary_restart.exact_allowance_semantics: 256 total including intact in Package A/C; 128 total including intact in Package B
ordinary_restart.method: same discovery family without diversity pressure or packing-aware feedback

model_roles: lowest fixed eligible canonical hard student
lowest fixed eligible canonical soft student

null_profiles.undercoverage: report layer as incomplete/unavailable; do not impute or collapse

actual_resource_binding: provider/scheduler and account only if actually available
machine count and hardware class for every worker
qualified CPU, CUDA, or MPS status per hardware class
minimum-of-three post-warmup training, model-loop hard-concrete, and exact-evaluation throughput
host CPU cores reserved per active accelerator
per-machine availability intervals and permitted hours
queue latency, preemption behavior, and measured scheduling efficiency
storage_retry_export_profile.export: sealed bundle to a Stage 14 verified destination, resumable transfer, independent byte/hash verification, and no source deletion
storage_retry_export_profile.gate_visibility: only completeness, failures, resources, storage, and integrity; no comparative scientific direction
storage_retry_export_profile.launch_blocker: if no verified configuration completes the protected core within H_science, block launch pending prospective amendment
storage_retry_export_profile.optional_admission: Task 3, then Task 4, then Task 5; only after protected completion is secure and only when the entire next manifest increment fits measured remaining capacity

capacity_equations: training_capacity = sum over machines and intervals of qualified_training_rate * usable_interval_seconds * measured_efficiency
hard_concrete_capacity = analogous sum using model-in-loop rate
exact_capacity = analogous sum using standalone CPU exact rate
host CPU support reservations are subtracted before standalone CPU capacity is computed
school_mac_branch.hardware_classes: class k records machine count M_k, CPU cores, RAM, optional MPS device, and disk quotas
school_mac_branch.optional_rule: after protected completion is secure, admit Task 3, then Task 4, then Task 5 only when measured remaining interval capacity can finish the entire next increment
school_mac_branch.pass_rule: protected core must finish within H_science with memory/storage quotas and audit reserve intact; otherwise launch blocks
school_mac_branch.permitted_hours: availability intervals I_{k,m}; capacity is integrated over intervals, never count*nominal wall time
school_mac_branch.qualified_rates: r_train_cpu[k], r_hc_cpu[k], r_exact_cpu[k], and optional r_train_mps[k]/r_hc_mps[k] only after exact and semantic MPS qualification
school_mac_branch.schedule_rule: run the dependency-closed protected DAG against actual intervals; CPU-only is mandatory when MPS is absent or unqualified

storage_retry_export_profile.scientific_dag: complete dependency-closed P3 manifest generated from approved RD-001 through RD-012 values

scientific_window.stage14_binding: H_total = total qualified permitted hours across verified availability intervals

hard.eligibility: exact argmax agreement on every input

training_profile.replacement_rule: none outside the predeclared attempt slots
training_profile.stop_rule: stop after eligible target is reached or all fixed slots resolve; retain every earlier failure
